data.one_liner: Animated bottom navigation bar with multiple styles
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable bottom navigation bar with several animated styles. It supports icon data or custom widgets for each item and exposes a callback for selection changes.
use_when: You need a bottom navigation bar with animation
You want to use custom widgets or icons for the bar items
You prefer a simple, declarative API without extra dependencies
avoid_when: You need a full navigation solution with routing
You require platform-specific navigation patterns like tabs with nested navigation
strengths: Multiple animated styles (bubble, double bullet, label slide)
Simple API with no extra dependencies
weaknesses: No built‑in routing or state management integration
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and use widget in Scaffold.bottomNavigationBar
